questionnaire: Balanced Inventory of Desirable Responding Version 6
item: Once I’ve made up my mind other people can seldom change my opinion.
When I’m upset, my emotions feel overwhelming
I consider the people I work with to be my friends.
When I’m upset, I have difficulty controlling my behaviours
It’s hard for me to find the words to describe what I’m thinking.
I believe some of my thoughts are abnormal or bad and I shouldn’t think that way.
I am confused about how I feel
I often think that what I have experienced is much worse than what others have experienced.
I don’t pay attention to what I’m doing because I’m daydreaming, worrying, or otherwise distracted.
When another person does better than I do‚ I get tense and aroused
How I dress is important to me.
If I think something unpleasant is going to happen I usually get pretty "worked up."
I often act on the spur of the moment.
It's hard for me to find the time to do things such as get a haircut.
Criticism or scolding hurts me quite a bit.
I feel worried when I think I have done poorly at something important.
I usually remain calm without getting frustrated when things are not going smoothly.
I tend to worry about what other people think of me.
When good things happen to me, it affects me strongly.
I often feel lonely because I have few close friends with whom to share my concerns.
